texts.preamble: The Cancer Patients Aid Association vs The Government Of Karnataka on 6 August, 2013 Bench: K.L.Manjunath, Ravi Malimath 1 In The High Court Of Karnataka At Bangalore Dated This The 6Th Day Of August 2013 Present The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice K.L.Manjunath And The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice Ravi Malimath Writ Petition No.23661 Of 2012(Gm-Res) Between: The Cancer Patients Aid Association A registered society, Having its Registered Office at: 5, Malhotra House, Opposite Gpo, Mumbai - 400 001 Represented by its Chairman & Founding Manager Mr.Yogendra K.Sapru. ...Petitioner (By Sri Trppti Poddar, Advocate for Sri Jayna Kothari, Advocate) 2 And: 1. The Government of Karnataka Health and Family Welfare Department The Cancer Patients Aid Association vs The Government Of Karnataka on 6 August, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22418253/ 1 Room No.105, 1st Floor, Vikas Souda Bangalore - 560 001 Represented by its Principal Secretary. 2. The Food Safety Commissioner For Karnataka Health & Family Welfare Department, 4th Floor, Ipp Annexe, Anand Rao Circle, Bangalore - 560 009.
texts.arguments: 2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondent submits that the writ petition has become infructuous, because the State Government of Karnataka has banned manufacture, sale and distribution of gutkha, pan masala and all other forms of chewing Tobacco containing tobacco and nicotine, in whatsoever form w.e.f. 30.05.2013. 3.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondent submits that the writ petition has become infructuous, because the State Government of Karnataka has banned manufacture, sale and distribution of gutkha, pan masala and all other forms of chewing Tobacco containing tobacco and nicotine, in whatsoever form w.e.f. 30.05.2013. 3.
